meta.title: Bidding before the window opens is refused
warnings: the QA memory is not built, so the plan was written without it — run `npm run rag:build`

steps.note: Open an existing event for the bidding test.
Verify the event is upcoming, before its bidding window has opened.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier portal.
Open the event's pricing round before bidding starts.
Attempt to submit a bid and require the portal to refuse it or keep submission disabled.
Return to the buyer console to verify no response was created.
Assert that the buyer sees no vendor response after the refused bid.
